verdict.rationale: Heap documents a public server-side REST API covering custom event tracking (single and bulk up to 1000 events), identity, account properties, and user deletion. It also serves an llms.txt and markdown docs that agents can read. However, the evidenced API is ingestion and data-management only, with no documented endpoints for querying analytics, reports, or charts, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: read/query API for analytics results and reports, programmatic configuration of definitions/dashboards, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
